label: The Metropolis acceptance rule
subgoals: Compute the cost change of the proposed move
Accept a worsening move with probability e to the minus delta over T

label: Choosing a temperature
subgoals: Choose the target acceptance probability for a typical uphill move
Take the natural logarithm of that probability
Divide minus delta by it to get the temperature

label: Expected acceptances in a batch
subgoals: Assign probability one to non-increasing moves
Compute e to the minus delta over T for each increasing move
Sum the probabilities for the expected number of acceptances
